description: Election Commission - M. A. S. Munasingha was selected as the member of the Matale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Matale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a replacement member after a seat became vacant due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. The content falls squarely within electoral processes and candidate nominations for local authorities, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
